title: The Figure Without a Signature

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Three readings make a month and none of them knows what the grain cost. The bell keeps its gap, the slate keeps its figure, and the price stands where nobody set it down.
epigraph.attribution: A saying at the reading block in the Cross of Sill, told in Frost

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and ninety-seven to two hundred and ninety-nine days, six months and one hundred and seventeen to one hundred and nineteen days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing and is never a break in the narration: the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the six hearings of the full note kept beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell kept beside the told; the told figure beside the paid with Frost's first and second arithmetics locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road and the printed one in twelve unchallenged; the dressed grain turned under wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure; the stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate of ice called weather and entered nowhere; the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying held beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession and not paid; Ilva's ninth record-first hand kept nine with the notched birch strip unread in her sleeve and no figure coming off the stick, no tenth hand filed; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Tarn's loan uncalled, the warm stone cold and unreconciled, Jorra's promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed, Garl held in objects with his name unspoken; the dozen small coordinations of the hand entered on the sixth place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule. On Frost 30 the third and last reading of Frost comes to the Cross and changes the district's arithmetic a third time for the month in a way that cannot be changed back, while the figure read is still not the figure paid; the finding that three readings are three and not one account is kept on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain or the boy's own kept gaps. No present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered word; the old life is a lens and never a scene.
places: the flat stone by the well
the reading block under the moot-post

scenes.title: The Twenty-Eighth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{297}{Frost 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and sixty-eighth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 81, the reader has just read it. Carry 296 to 297 exact, six months and one hundred and seventeen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-seven days with its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places — the kiln's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — and agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands. Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell beside the told in its square; the told figure beside the paid with Frost's first and second arithmetics locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box, one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying held beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand with a finger between and not a witness; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread and no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth; Garl kept in objects, his name unspoken (T061/T082 held, T078, T015/T041/T047 held, T080 held, T101 held, T036/T076 held, T009/T013/T092 held). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says 'The house will keep it', keeps her finger above the charcoal, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100 held). She turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and gives it no figure, so that the arithmetic two mornings off will pass over a thing whose cost it does not know (T077). The stayed frost on the well lip, the skinned trough and the plate of ice on its flat stone are still weather entered nowhere (T083/T085 held). The hand goes up an inch and takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds it, and lets it go on the same note: the one hundred and sixty-ninth answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082). Frost's third reading stands two mornings off and is not brought into this day or made a sign (T015/T041/T047 held).

scenes.title: The Count Kept in Wood
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 297, no new dated heading: afternoon of Frost 28 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, the boards and the towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood; the trough skinned over; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). The stayed frost, the skinned water and the silt-clouded plate of ice set out of the path of feet are three coverings in three places kept with a finger between, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T083/T085 held). The grain is turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure (T077). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood 'Six counted. The next I don't count', brings the ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, draws the breath he does not spend, agrees with the early thaw and the late and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying, his stroke going over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying; the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes up or down the road (T036/T076, T006, T009/T013/T092). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger, parts dusty from clean forearms, speaks to the wheel before any person, tells a pot 'You'll do', knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it, puts the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and gives the unnamed men in the back room no name; the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T061/T082, T101 held). Ilva of the firing work is glimpsed once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; asked what the month's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there, the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, copied, counted, asked about or joined to any slate and no figure comes off the wood, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it, 'Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.' The boy takes the order of reaching and keeps it on the ninth hand's own place; he files no tenth and does not make her a reader, a witness or a party to an account (T080 advanced and not paid, held). A wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid (T064 held). At the going of the light Sella carries him up, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot and keeps the charcoal unread. The hand takes a small intake at the very end of the day and lets it go whole on the same note: the one hundred and seventieth answer, exact and worth nothing, and the count closes at 297 exact (T061/T082, T071/T072). Nothing is joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended; the second reading behind and the third two mornings ahead are not brought in as lessons or signs.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Ninth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{298}{Frost 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into first light of an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; Frost 29 comes on its own morning and nothing seen at the well yesterday is brought into it as a lesson, sign, mending, witness or payment. Carry 297 to 298 exact, six months and one hundred and eighteen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-eight days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before — hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool, the sour breath of the corner called the thaw, the river low over lower under the finger's-width door, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell. Body inventory in the old order: one stiff brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed empty place and no third, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; he knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; the older keeps the inventory and the younger keeps the wanting, neither with authority over the other (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh kept empty; the heard bell beside the told; the told figure beside the paid with Frost's two arithmetics behind and unread, one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; the three shapings held with a finger between every pair and not a witness; nine hands with the ninth strip unread and no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth; the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two (T061/T082 held, T078, T015/T041/T047 held, T080 held, T101, T036/T076, T065/T095 held). Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the wool, pot, broom, water and fire and never to the basket, 'the house' where another woman would say 'I', the half-pace, the finger above the charcoal, the pot rim two inches out with the half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark is not touched, because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100 held). The dressed grain is turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure (T077); the stayed frost and the plate of ice are still weather entered nowhere (T083/T085 held). The hand goes up an inch and holds a small intake against the kiln's fourth low pull without carrying it into the missing fifth, then lets it go whole on the same note: the one hundred and seventy-first answer, exact, complete and worth nothing (T061/T082, T088 held). The reading stands one morning off and is still not brought into a day that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047 held).

scenes.title: What the House Keeps By Not Doing
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Frost 29 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the well and its flat stone, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed, the boards and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending the way heat goes out of a pot lifted off the coals and set on a cold stone; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). Sella goes wide around the seven walked-around places, and the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the clouded plate of ice stay weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The dressed grain is turned once more under the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure (T077). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, tells the kindling 'Six counted. The next I don't count', and brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, draws the breath he does not spend and keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent; the stroke goes on over the bright patch without the half-check, Ash stays worked into the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holds the little light, the loft stone is cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes (T036/T076, T006, T009/T013/T092). Jorra comes through with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note he knows three turns ahead, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and get no name and no word that the room is cold; he's not Vail stays sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). Under the roof the boy registers that the house keeps itself by not-doings — two lines unswept, the mark untouched, the charcoal unread, the fifth pull unsupplied, the loan uncalled, no number spoken over the basket, the crust not lifted — and he sets that finding on a place of its own apart from his own kept gaps with a finger between, refusing to lay the two together for want of a payer, so the absence of the joining is itself kept and not spent (T061/T082, T071/T072). The three shapings stay three and not a witness, the nine hands stay nine with Ilva's strip unread and offstage today, the row stays at five askings with one shaping and no witness (T080 held, T101 held). A small dry scrape comes from the loft and is filed on a place of its own, not joined to the damper fraction, the shelf beat or the flagstone half-check (T006 held, T062 held). At the very end of the day a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his is let go whole on the same note: the one hundred and seventy-second answer, exact, complete and worth nothing, and the count closes at 298 exact (T061/T082, T071/T072). Frost 30 stands one morning off and is not brought in or made a sign.

scenes.title: The Third Reading
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, the dated \daymark{299}{Frost 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: morning of the month's third and last Account-day and market at the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post, the pot board and the out-of-line landing below the north bridge; the clay road up toward High Kiln and on to Greybank and the terrace come back on stage as ground already drawn. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T015/T041/T047):** Frost's third reading comes to the Cross and the district's arithmetic changes a third time for the month in a way that cannot be changed back. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner; under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all. He wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passes a finger over the figure, reads 'one in twelve, as the notice says' low into the two hundred, sends the figure over the basket twice — once for the moot and once for the households that came late — calls the levy and denies it with 'The levy is called. It is not called by me' and 'your house', never 'I', taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and goes off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the third true subtraction of Frost inside, believing he has done a kindness (T015/T041/T047, T077). The printed figure stands unchallenged and the figure read is still not the figure paid; the space between figure and price has no signature. The reading answers nothing for the dressed grain lying covered under wool at the rack end, which is read over by a number that does not know what it cost, nor for the man carried out on Day 188, nor for the hand that went in on Seed 15 and did not come back (T077, T064, T098 carried). The boy takes the finding that three readings are three and not one account and keeps it on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, doctrine or mending and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain or his own kept gaps (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, keeps a half-pace from every open slate and stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, carrying him home at the going of the light saying nothing (T058/T079). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told bell of the Long Night and not folded into any count (T078). Hessa Rale takes the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on and unread, her hand to it before her eyes to the crowd, answering the question put and not the one behind it; no figure comes off the slate, she does not look toward any woman at the well, and the three shapings do not make her a reader (T080 held). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and slate to his forearm (T090 held). Across the square a silent woman's green at the pot board and a foundling's shape at the market's edge are a colour and a shape on places that do not touch, with no eighth of either, never named, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration, never joined to a loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held). At a quiet interval in the afternoon the hand takes a small intake and holds it whole beside the reading without carrying the bell's gap into it or supplying a figure: the one hundred and seventy-third answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082, T078 held). The count reaches 299 exact; nothing is joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended, and no payer stands under any of the three arithmetics.

scenes.title: Frost Goes Out
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 299, Frost 30, the going of the light and the small hours at Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the hearth, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Frost goes out in its last tend without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months — the older women by weather, the slatemen by the number of Account-days — is set right or left wrong. Frost's three arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln with one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; three readings are three and not one account, and the finding is kept on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, doctrine or mending and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain or the boy's own kept gaps (T015/T041/T047 held, T077, T061/T082). Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order — one stiff brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed empty place and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and wrist with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform — and the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse buys him nothing at two inches of air (T060/T086). Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot and said 'The house will keep it', kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along a row standing with two gaps and gave neither gap a figure, glanced once at the clay jar standing cold under its lead glaze, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the one grey streak showed pale, and set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; she did not touch the widow's mark, because a going of the light is not an opening and the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour, and the next opening stands in a later month's first firing, far off, not hoped for and not counted toward (T058/T079, T100 held). Tarn keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, and the loan uncalled with no collector on the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra keeps his dusty forearms and his silence whole, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of her unfinished sentence, withholds the full note, keeps he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling's name neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). Garl stays in objects — salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with the finer grey beside it, uncalled tile debt — his name unspoken 299 days (T009/T013/T092). The stayed frost, the skinned trough and the plate of ice clouded with silt on its flat stone stay weather entered nowhere, no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held); nine hands stay nine with Ilva's strip unread, the three shapings stay three with no witness, the row stays at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T080 held, T101 held, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Under the floor the carried fire keeps its fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-nine days with its payer unnamed, and nobody supplies the pull (T088). At the very end of the day a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his is let go on the same note, whole and unjoined, carried into neither the fire's missing fifth nor the bell's gap nor the river's low note; the hand comes down on the river's note as it always does and the gap stays a gap: the one hundred and seventy-fourth answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082). The hand lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Two hundred and ninety-nine stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and nineteen days are told by nobody; the fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed. Nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended; no thread was opened and none was closed. Bone comes on in the dark beyond the door and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.
